# environment_variables (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads environment variables with optional filtering and encoding (ephemeral).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Regex filter for variable names
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether to base64 encode values

### Read-Only

- `variables` (Map of String) Map of environment variables
